idle.title: Ready
idle.body: Start a session and talk. The microphone is only used while a session is open.
idle.note: Your microphone streams while the session runs. The server notices when you stop talking and answers on its own.

connecting.title: Connecting
connecting.body: Setting up the call. The model is not listening yet.

listening.title: Listening
listening.body: Say what you need. I answer when you stop.

interrupted.title: Interrupted
interrupted.body: I stopped. Go ahead, I am listening.

speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.body: Speak over me at any time to interrupt.

blocked.title: Microphone blocked
blocked.body: The browser did not give this page the microphone.
blocked.card: Click the lock icon in the address bar, set Microphone to Allow, then try again. Nothing was recorded.

lost.title: Connection lost
lost.body: The link to the server dropped.
lost.card: The WebRTC link failed. The conversation so far stays in the transcript.

error.title: The session stopped
error.body: Something went wrong while setting up or running the call.

nopipe.title: Talk needs a pipeline model
nopipe.body: A pipeline model joins a speech-to-text model, a chat model and a text-to-speech model into one voice assistant. None is configured yet. Create one, or find the models in the gallery first.

detail.insecure: Microphone access needs HTTPS or localhost.
detail.failed: The call could not be set up: {{message}}

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.empty: What you say and what the model answers appears here as it happens. It is not saved.

settings.title: Session settings
settings.voicePlaceholder: Voice name (leave blank for the model default)
settings.languagePlaceholder: Language code, for example en (blank detects it)
settings.instructionsHelp: Sent as the session instructions. Keep them short: replies are spoken.
settings.manageDesc: Let the model query LocalAI: models, backends and system info.
settings.manageLocked: Fixed while a session is open. End the session to change it.
settings.selfContained: Self-contained any-to-any model: it handles voice detection, transcription, the language model and speech by itself.

toasts.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
